evals.prompt: I just made changes to src/utils/helpers.ts — added a new formatCurrency function. Commit --yes.
evals.expected_output: Shows proposed commit message, marks it as 'Auto-approved', executes git add and git commit without asking for confirmation. Commit uses conventional commits format with appropriate type and scope.
expectations: Runs git status or git diff to analyze changes
Shows a commit message using conventional commits format (e.g., feat(utils): ...)
Does NOT ask 'Proceed?' or any confirmation question
Mentions 'Auto-approved' or similar indicator in the output
Executes git add and git commit without user confirmation

evals.prompt: comita minhas mudancas --sim, adicionei um novo endpoint de health check em src/server/health.ts
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the Portuguese --sim flag as auto-approve. Shows proposal marked as auto-approved and commits immediately. Does not ask for confirmation.
expectations: Recognizes '--sim' as auto-approve flag (Portuguese equivalent of --yes)
Shows a commit message in conventional commits format
Does NOT ask for confirmation — executes immediately
Mentions 'Auto-approved' or similar in output
Runs git add and git commit

evals.prompt: Commit only src/components/ — I refactored the button and card components.
evals.expected_output: Only stages and commits files under src/components/. Shows commit proposal scoped to that path. Uses git status/diff with the path filter.
expectations: Uses path scoping — git status or git diff is scoped to src/components/
Only files under src/components/ appear in the proposed commit
Asks for confirmation before committing (no auto-approve flag)
Commit message is scoped to components (e.g., refactor(ui): ...)
Does NOT mention or include changes from outside src/components/

evals.prompt: commit -y src/shared/types.ts — updated the AgentConfig interface with new fields
evals.expected_output: Combines auto-approve with path scoping. Only commits src/shared/types.ts, shows auto-approved indicator, no confirmation.
expectations: Scopes to only src/shared/types.ts
Recognizes -y as auto-approve
Mentions 'Auto-approved' or equivalent
Does NOT ask for confirmation
Runs git add and git commit on the scoped file
